recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It removes the remaining contradictory wording while preserving the intended Address.type guidance; no additional core follow-up is indicated from the checked evidence.
issue_request: FHIR-17722 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 change request for the Address datatype. It reported that the Address note said addresses were postal, not physical locations, while the datatype definition and Address.type allowed visiting/physical-address use; the approved resolution was to reword the note to say Address describes postal addresses for administrative purposes, not absolute geographical coordinates, and that postal addresses are often used as proxies for physical locations.
initial_application: Git commit 89b894c3a3 applied GF#17722 by changing the root Address comment to the approved wording and partially updating the Address.type comment. The root comment remains correct, but the Address.type comment still quoted the obsolete "postal addresses, not physical locations" idea and preserved the contradiction the issue intended to remove.
additional_context: FHIR-16981 introduced the nearby physical-address clarification before FHIR-17722 and is the same wording family. source/fhir.ini maps datatypes to the datatypes page, so source/datatypes/address.xml is active build source. Jira searches found adjacent Location.address and official-address issues, but no later decision that reverses the FHIR-17722 wording; Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting record.
reconciliation: Updated only source/datatypes/address.xml, rewriting the Address.type comment to align with the final Address note: postal addresses are for administrative purposes rather than absolute coordinates, while they may still proxy visitable physical locations.
source_changes: source/datatypes/address.xml: rewrote the Address.type comment to remove the stale quote of the old Address note and align it with the approved administrative-purpose/absolute-coordinate wording.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the physical-address clarification that FHIR-17722 later refined; this fix preserves that clarification while aligning it with the final FHIR-17722 wording.
Addressed Location.address comments and confirms Location-specific handling is separate from the Address datatype contradiction.
Later official-address work affects Address.use/extension requirements, not the postal-vs-physical wording resolved here.
